indicadores.subtitulo: Orçamentos, pedidos e notas emitidas por cliente, vendedor e representante

opcoesSql: SELECT DISTINCT C007_Id AS valor, COALESCE(NULLIF(C007_Primeiro_Nome, ''), NULLIF(C007_Nome, ''), 'Sem nome') AS titulo
INNER JOIN C019 ON C019_C007_Id = C007_Id

sqlBase: SELECT T007_Id AS id, T007_Data_Emissao AS data,
CASE WHEN IFNULL(T007_D024_Id, 0) > 0 THEN CONCAT('cad:', T007_D024_Id) ELSE CONCAT('T007:', T007_Id) END AS clienteId,

COALESCE(NULLIF(D024_Nome_Empresa, ''), NULLIF(T007_Cliente_Razao, ''), 'Sem cliente') AS cliente, COALESCE(T007_C007_Id_Vendedor_Interno, 0) AS responsavelId, COALESCE(NULLIF(C007_Primeiro_Nome, ''), NULLIF(C007_Nome, ''), 'Sem vendedor') AS responsavel,
GREATEST(IFNULL(T007_Valor_Total, 0) - IFNULL(T007_Valor_Total_IPI, 0) - IFNULL(T007_Valor_Frete, 0), 0) AS valor, 0 AS convertido
INNER JOIN D006 ON D006_Id = T007_D006_Id
LEFT JOIN D024 ON D024_Id = T007_D024_Id
LEFT JOIN C007 ON C007_Id = T007_C007_Id_Vendedor_Interno
AND (:cliente = '' OR COALESCE(NULLIF(D024_Nome_Empresa, ''), NULLIF(T007_Cliente_Razao, ''), 'Sem cliente') LIKE CONCAT('%', :cliente, '%'))

orcamentos: SELECT T003_Id AS id, T003_Data_Emissao AS data,
CASE WHEN IFNULL(T003_D024_Id, 0) > 0 THEN CONCAT('cad:', T003_D024_Id) ELSE CONCAT('T003:', T003_Id) END AS clienteId,

COALESCE(NULLIF(D024_Nome_Empresa, ''), NULLIF(T003_Nome_Cliente, ''), 'Sem cliente') AS cliente, COALESCE(T003_C007_Id_Vendedor_Interno, 0) AS responsavelId, COALESCE(NULLIF(C007_Primeiro_Nome, ''), NULLIF(C007_Nome, ''), 'Sem vendedor') AS responsavel,

COALESCE(T003_Valor_Total, 0) AS valor, CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM T005 WHERE T005_C004_Id = :empresa AND T005_T003_Id = T003_Id AND IFNULL(T005_Flag_Status, 0) <> 8 AND IFNULL(T005_Flag_Devolucao, 'N') <> 'S') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS convertido
FROM T003
LEFT JOIN D024 ON D024_Id = T003_D024_Id
LEFT JOIN C007 ON C007_Id = T003_C007_Id_Vendedor_Interno
WHERE T003_C004_Id = :empresa
AND T003_Data_Emissao >= :dataInicio
AND T003_Data_Emissao < DATE_ADD(:dataFim, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
AND IFNULL(T003_Flag_Perdido, 'N') <> 'S'
AND IFNULL(T003_Flag_Status_Orcamento, '') <> 'C'
AND (:vendedor = '' OR T003_C007_Id_Vendedor_Interno = :vendedor)
AND (:cliente = '' OR COALESCE(NULLIF(D024_Nome_Empresa, ''), NULLIF(T003_Nome_Cliente, ''), 'Sem cliente') LIKE CONCAT('%', :cliente, '%'))
